quote: For any positive even number n, there are infinitely many prime gaps of size n (Polignac 1849); when n = 6, this addresses sexy primes (p, p+6)
note: The conjecture about infinitely many sexy primes (prime pairs differing by 6) was first formally stated as a special case of Polignac's more general conjecture about prime gaps of any even size. While Hardy-Littlewood proposed their broader k-tuple conjecture in 1923 which also encompasses sexy primes, Polignac's 1849 conjecture is the documented origin of the specific sexy primes case.
